previousRule: Roman, smart-track and cushion checkout adapters did not persist Shopify's successful draft ID. An immediate repeat could find an empty Shopify tag search and return an opaque server error even though the draft was created.
newRule: Persist a validated Shopify draft ID in a private immutable receipt before returning checkout. Bind receipts to owner, checkout kind, attempt and original contract tag. Reuse exact-ID Shopify validation on retry. Pending creates keep their one-shot claim and return a clear retryable response. Prices, delivery, discounts and purchase gates are unchanged.
reason: Live testing reproduced immediate Roman and smart-track retry failures with SHOPIFY_DRAFT_ORDER_PENDING; the identical track request later reused the original draft. The owner asked to investigate the delay. New tests cover recovery, uncertain writes, identity, immutability and private access.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner requested urgent checkout fixes and investigation of this retry delay. This follow-up is prepared for review; protected test changes require a new exact-head Nylon1 approval comment before merge and release.
